title: Vocabulary Lesson 1
definition: To make an action or process easy or easier.
example_sentence: The new system will facilitate flawless communication.
common_mistake: Do not use 'facilitate' for simple mechanical tasks.
quiz_question: Which word is a premium alternative to 'make easier'?

title: Vocabulary Lesson 2
definition: To use something that you already have in order to achieve something new or better.
example_sentence: We can leverage our advanced vocabulary to secure better job prospects.
common_mistake: Avoid using leverage as a noun when verb form works.
pronunciation_tip: Pronounce with a strong initial 'L' sound.
correct_answer: To use existing assets to achieve better results

title: Vocabulary Lesson 3
definition: A detailed plan or route of a journey.
example_sentence: Let us finalize the flight itinerary before we check in.
common_mistake: Do not misspell as 'itinery'.

title: Vocabulary Lesson 4
definition: Perfect, with no problems or bad parts.
example_sentence: Her pronunciation was absolutely impeccable.
common_mistake: Do not say 'very impeccable' because it is already absolute.
quiz_question: Which word is a synonym for 'perfect'?

title: Vocabulary Lesson 5
definition: To work jointly on an activity or project.
example_sentence: Teams must collaborate to achieve intermediate goals.
common_mistake: Use 'collaborate on' a project, not 'collaborate a project'.
pronunciation_tip: Avoid adding a heavy stress on the 'co'.

title: Vocabulary Lesson 6
definition: Showing an ability to understand and share the feelings of others.
example_sentence: He gave an empathetic response to the client's concern.
common_mistake: Do not confuse with 'sympathetic'.

title: Vocabulary Lesson 7
definition: Able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions.
example_sentence: English learners are highly resilient when correcting mistakes.
common_mistake: Ensure stress is on the second syllable.
correct_answer: Someone who recovers quickly from difficulty
